somali-current-summer.name: Somali Current — boreal summer
somali-current-summer.answerNote: Northward along the Somali coast in boreal summer.

somali-current-winter.name: Somali Current — boreal winter
somali-current-winter.answerNote: Southward along the Somali coast in boreal winter.

southwest-monsoon-current.name: Southwest Monsoon Current — boreal summer
southwest-monsoon-current.answerNote: Eastward across the northern Indian Ocean; Southwest names the monsoon season, not the bearing.

northeast-monsoon-current.name: Northeast Monsoon Current — boreal winter
northeast-monsoon-current.answerNote: Westward across the northern Indian Ocean; Northeast names the monsoon season, not the bearing.
